address: 120 Fujin Street, Songshan District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Warm colours and asymmetrical curves lend the room a welcoming casual vibe, but it’s the picture windows overlooking a patio of lush greenery and a winding path that make a meal here a true respite from the hustle and bustle. Come for lunch as the views are especially charming during the day. The à la carte menu prominently features Taiwanese plant-based whole foods, jazzed up with delicate Asian flavours and modern plating.
